rust_summary: announce a player name that will join as a fake player (`native_expect_fake_player`): fake from its first packet on.
doc_summary: `native_expect_fake_player(name, fake)` says that a player named `name` (any case) will join as a fake player, a mod's bot with no client, or not any more. The player is then fake from its first packet on, so its join sends and builds nothing a client-less player cannot read (no login records, recipe book, command tree, player list or advancements); `native_set_player_fake` marks a player that is already online. False off a server. Bundles need "hooks": @API:expect_fake_player@.
